description:
Search active job vacancies on Finder. country: ISO code (ru, by, kz, kg, de, fr, be, ch, se, id; ru = finder.work, Russia).
query: job title / keywords in any language (e.g. 'бухгалтер', 'python developer'). city: city name as written
locally (e.g. 'Минск', 'Алматы', 'Berlin'). Returns up to `limit` (≤20) newest matches with links to finder.work.

city.description: City name as written locally, e.g. 'Минск', 'Алматы', 'Berlin'. Empty = whole country
city.title: City

country.description: Country ISO code: ru (Russia, finder.work), by, kz, kg, de, fr, be, ch, se, id
country.title: Country

query.description: Job title or keywords in any language, e.g. 'бухгалтер', 'python developer'. Empty = newest vacancies
query.title: Query

name: search_vacancies

country.description: Country code (search results) or country name (get_vacancy)
country.title: Country

employment_type.description: Employment type, e.g. full_time, part_time, contract
employment_type.title: Employment Type

salary.description: Advertised salary range with currency, e.g. '2 000–2 500 BYN'
salary.title: Salary

url.description: Vacancy page on finder.work where the user can read more and apply
url.title: Url

title: Search vacancies
